Ratio updates write the exact shader data; reviveProgress callback delegates smooth interpolation only for nonnil values. All status changes request state reevaluation. Close registration/postload precede SetupReviveProgressBar and SetupBleedoutProgressBar, then self return. This consumes combat state and does not implement revive/deposit timing or native cancellation.
